text:
minh: Heads-up — seeing a spike in Xid 13 and Xid 79 on eu-west1 A10 pool starting ~02:00 UTC. Rate ~0.6/hour per card vs baseline 0.05. Looks correlated to two recent changes: tokenization switch to new BPE packer + increasing dynamic batch timeout to 60ms.
jordan: ugh. any tenant or optype skew?
minh: Mostly long-chat generation requests and a few heavy embedding jobs that accidentally route to the A10 pool. Workload mix shifted: chat (seq len 2k) + long-context injection.
lisa: Can you paste a short log slice? stack / nv driver messages? :eyes:
minh: ```
[2026-03-18T01:59:58Z] gpu0: Xid 13: CE error, fault addr 0x7f2a3...
[2026-03-18T02:00:03Z] runtime: decode failed, kv cache invalidation
[2026-03-18T02:05:12Z] gpu3: Xid 79: ECC multi-bit error detected
```
minh: Also noticed these appear more on smaller batches (1-4) with many tiny requests rather than steady big batches.
tariq: Interesting — Xid 13 often maps to illegal memory access during decode kernels, Xid 79 is ECC. Could be memory pressure from KV cache + many small concurrent decode calls.
jordan: Any PCIe or ECC counters from node?
minh: Node metrics show elevated L2 cache misses and /sys log reports some corrected ECC events prior to the uncorrected ones. NIC looked fine.
lisa: We rolled tokenization change yesterday that packs subword spans differently — increases average sequence length by ~30% for chat. That would increase KV cache footprint.
minh: hypothesis: longer sequences + small batch concurrency -> more KV cache churn -> kernel code hits bad fast-path causing Xid13 on some A10 firmware combos. Xid79 appears when memory errors escalate.
tariq: Can we reproduce? Run small-scale local with same model + tokenization + high-concurrency small batches. If we trigger, we can isolate kernel path.
jordan: Meanwhile, recommend soft-drain affected cards and pin long-chat tenants to h100 pool if capacity allows. Also throttle embeddings routing to A10.
minh: I'll soft-drain 3 pods (rack eu-west1-r4) and add routing rule for chat-heavy tenant -> h100 for next 6h.
isa (rebuild-bot): Auto-notice: initiated soft-drain for node gpu-azr-07 (3 pods).
lisa: Can we add a telemetry tag for 'tokenizer=pack-v2' on requests so we can filter traces?
tariq: yes, add header X-Tokenizer: pack-v2; can filter in tracing.
jordan: Also capture nvcr.io/driver and firmware versions on the drained nodes; open ticket to NVIDIA if reproduces.
minh: action items: 1) reproduce locally (tariq + lisa) 2) soft-drain + route tenants (minh) 3) add telemetry tag + collect full dmesg + ECC counters (jordan) 4) smoke test quantized variant with same input (lisa). I'll post updates.
minh: quick note — cost impact estimate if we pin chat to H100: ~+18% on hourly infra cost but reduces incident risk.
jordan: ok let's do that for 12h window and reassess. :thumbsup:
tariq: if repro succeeds, plan: patch runtime to add backpressure on KV cache allocations and tune continuous batching thresholds.
lisa: ack, starting local repro now. Will drop logs here.
minh: thanks all — will monitor error rate and update thread. :eyes:
